en.text: Paul, looking steadfastly at the council, said, “Brothers, I have lived before God in all good conscience until today.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗定睛看着公会的人，说：「弟兄们，我在 神面前行事为人都是凭着良心，直到今日。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅定睛看着公會的人，說：「弟兄們，我在上帝面前行事為人都是憑着良心，直到今日。」

en.text: The high priest, Ananias, commanded those who stood by him to strike him on the mouth.

zhSimplified.text: 大祭司亚拿尼亚就吩咐旁边站着的人打他的嘴。

zhTraditional.text: 大祭司亞拿尼亞就吩咐旁邊站着的人打他的嘴。

en.text: Then Paul said to him, “God will strike you, you whitewashed wall! Do you sit to judge me according to the law, and command me to be struck contrary to the law?”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗对他说：「你这粉饰的墙， 神要打你！你坐堂为的是按律法审问我，你竟违背律法，吩咐人打我吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅對他說：「你這粉飾的牆，上帝要打你！你坐堂為的是按律法審問我，你竟違背律法，吩咐人打我嗎？」

en.text: Those who stood by said, “Do you malign God’s high priest?”

zhSimplified.text: 站在旁边的人说：「你辱骂 神的大祭司吗？」

zhTraditional.text: 站在旁邊的人說：「你辱罵上帝的大祭司嗎？」

en.text: Paul said, “I didn’t know, brothers, that he was high priest. For it is written, ‘You shall not speak evil of a ruler of your people.’”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗说：「弟兄们，我不晓得他是大祭司；经上记着说：『不可毁谤你百姓的官长。』」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅說：「弟兄們，我不曉得他是大祭司；經上記着說：『不可毀謗你百姓的官長。』」

en.text: But when Paul perceived that the one part were Sadducees and the other Pharisees, he cried out in the council, “Men and brothers, I am a Pharisee, a son of Pharisees. Concerning the hope and resurrection of the dead I am being judged!”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗看出大众一半是撒都该人，一半是法利赛人，就在公会中大声说：「弟兄们，我是法利赛人，也是法利赛人的子孙。我现在受审问，是为盼望死人复活。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅看出大眾一半是撒都該人，一半是法利賽人，就在公會中大聲說：「弟兄們，我是法利賽人，也是法利賽人的子孫。我現在受審問，是為盼望死人復活。」

en.text: When he had said this, an argument arose between the Pharisees and Sadducees, and the crowd was divided.

zhSimplified.text: 说了这话，法利赛人和撒都该人就争论起来，会众分为两党。

zhTraditional.text: 說了這話，法利賽人和撒都該人就爭論起來，會眾分為兩黨。

en.text: For the Sadducees say that there is no resurrection, nor angel, nor spirit; but the Pharisees confess all of these.

zhSimplified.text: 因为撒都该人说，没有复活，也没有天使和鬼魂；法利赛人却说，两样都有。

zhTraditional.text: 因為撒都該人說，沒有復活，也沒有天使和鬼魂；法利賽人卻說，兩樣都有。

en.text: A great clamor arose, and some of the scribes of the Pharisees’ part stood up, and contended, saying, “We find no evil in this man. But if a spirit or angel has spoken to him, let’s not fight against God!”

zhSimplified.text: 于是大大地喧嚷起来。有几个法利赛党的文士站起来争辩说：「我们看不出这人有什么恶处，倘若有鬼魂或是天使对他说过话，怎么样呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 於是大大地喧嚷起來。有幾個法利賽黨的文士站起來爭辯說：「我們看不出這人有甚麼惡處，倘若有鬼魂或是天使對他說過話，怎麼樣呢？」

en.text: When a great argument arose, the commanding officer, fearing that Paul would be torn in pieces by them, commanded the soldiers to go down and take him by force from among them and bring him into the barracks.

zhSimplified.text: 那时大起争吵，千夫长恐怕保罗被他们扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他从众人当中抢出来，带进营楼去。

zhTraditional.text: 那時大起爭吵，千夫長恐怕保羅被他們扯碎了，就吩咐兵丁下去，把他從眾人當中搶出來，帶進營樓去。

en.text: The following night, the Lord stood by him and said, “Cheer up, Paul, for as you have testified about me at Jerusalem, so you must testify also at Rome.”

zhSimplified.text: 当夜，主站在保罗旁边，说：「放心吧！你怎样在耶路撒冷为我作见证，也必怎样在罗马为我作见证。」

zhTraditional.text: 當夜，主站在保羅旁邊，說：「放心吧！你怎樣在耶路撒冷為我作見證，也必怎樣在羅馬為我作見證。」

en.text: When it was day, some of the Jews banded together and bound themselves under a curse, saying that they would neither eat nor drink until they had killed Paul.

zhSimplified.text: 到了天亮，犹太人同谋起誓，说：「若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。」

zhTraditional.text: 到了天亮，猶太人同謀起誓，說：「若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。」

en.text: There were more than forty people who had made this conspiracy.

zhSimplified.text: 这样同心起誓的有四十多人。

zhTraditional.text: 這樣同心起誓的有四十多人。

en.text: They came to the chief priests and the elders, and said, “We have bound ourselves under a great curse to taste nothing until we have killed Paul.

zhSimplified.text: 他们来见祭司长和长老，说：「我们已经起了一个大誓，若不先杀保罗就不吃什么。

zhTraditional.text: 他們來見祭司長和長老，說：「我們已經起了一個大誓，若不先殺保羅就不吃甚麼。

en.text: Now therefore, you with the council inform the commanding officer that he should bring him down to you tomorrow, as though you were going to judge his case more exactly. We are ready to kill him before he comes near.”

zhSimplified.text: 现在你们和公会要知会千夫长，叫他带下保罗到你们这里来，假作要详细察考他的事；我们已经预备好了，不等他来到跟前就杀他。」

zhTraditional.text: 現在你們和公會要知會千夫長，叫他帶下保羅到你們這裏來，假作要詳細察考他的事；我們已經預備好了，不等他來到跟前就殺他。」

en.text: But Paul’s sister’s son heard they were lying in wait, and he came and entered into the barracks and told Paul.

zhSimplified.text: 保罗的外甥听见他们设下埋伏，就来到营楼里告诉保罗。

zhTraditional.text: 保羅的外甥聽見他們設下埋伏，就來到營樓裏告訴保羅。

en.text: Paul summoned one of the centurions and said, “Bring this young man to the commanding officer, for he has something to tell him.”

zhSimplified.text: 保罗请一个百夫长来，说：「你领这少年人去见千夫长，他有事告诉他。」

zhTraditional.text: 保羅請一個百夫長來，說：「你領這少年人去見千夫長，他有事告訴他。」

en.text: So he took him and brought him to the commanding officer and said, “Paul, the prisoner, summoned me and asked me to bring this young man to you. He has something to tell you.”

zhSimplified.text: 于是把他领去见千夫长，说：「被囚的保罗请我到他那里，求我领这少年人来见你；他有事告诉你。」

zhTraditional.text: 於是把他領去見千夫長，說：「被囚的保羅請我到他那裏，求我領這少年人來見你；他有事告訴你。」

en.text: The commanding officer took him by the hand, and going aside, asked him privately, “What is it that you have to tell me?”

zhSimplified.text: 千夫长就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下问他说：「你有什么事告诉我呢？」

zhTraditional.text: 千夫長就拉着他的手，走到一旁，私下問他說：「你有甚麼事告訴我呢？」

en.text: He said, “The Jews have agreed to ask you to bring Paul down to the council tomorrow, as though intending to inquire somewhat more accurately concerning him.

zhSimplified.text: 他说：「犹太人已经约定，要求你明天带下保罗到公会里去，假作要详细查问他的事。

zhTraditional.text: 他說：「猶太人已經約定，要求你明天帶下保羅到公會裏去，假作要詳細查問他的事。

en.text: Therefore don’t yield to them, for more than forty men lie in wait for him, who have bound themselves under a curse to neither eat nor drink until they have killed him. Now they are ready, looking for the promise from you.”

zhSimplified.text: 你切不要随从他们；因为他们有四十多人埋伏，已经起誓说，若不先杀保罗就不吃不喝。现在预备好了，只等你应允。」

zhTraditional.text: 你切不要隨從他們；因為他們有四十多人埋伏，已經起誓說，若不先殺保羅就不吃不喝。現在預備好了，只等你應允。」

en.text: So the commanding officer let the young man go, charging him, “Tell no one that you have revealed these things to me.”

zhSimplified.text: 于是千夫长打发少年人走，嘱咐他说：「不要告诉人你将这事报给我了。」

zhTraditional.text: 於是千夫長打發少年人走，囑咐他說：「不要告訴人你將這事報給我了。」

en.text: He called to himself two of the centurions, and said, “Prepare two hundred soldiers to go as far as Caesarea, with seventy horsemen and two hundred men armed with spears, at the third hour of the night.”

zhSimplified.text: 千夫长便叫了两个百夫长来，说：「预备步兵二百，马兵七十，长枪手二百，今夜亥初往凯撒利亚去；

zhTraditional.text: 千夫長便叫了兩個百夫長來，說：「預備步兵二百，馬兵七十，長槍手二百，今夜亥初往凱撒利亞去；

en.text: He asked them to provide mounts, that they might set Paul on one, and bring him safely to Felix the governor.

zhSimplified.text: 也要预备牲口叫保罗骑上，护送到巡抚腓力斯那里去。」

zhTraditional.text: 也要預備牲口叫保羅騎上，護送到巡撫腓力斯那裏去。」

en.text: He wrote a letter like this:

zhSimplified.text: 千夫长又写了文书，

zhTraditional.text: 千夫長又寫了文書，

en.text: “Claudius Lysias to the most excellent governor Felix: Greetings.

zhSimplified.text: 大略说：「克劳第·吕西亚，请巡抚腓力斯大人安。

zhTraditional.text: 大略說：「克勞第‧呂西亞，請巡撫腓力斯大人安。

en.text: “This man was seized by the Jews, and was about to be killed by them when I came with the soldiers and rescued him, having learned that he was a Roman.

zhSimplified.text: 这人被犹太人拿住，将要杀害，我得知他是罗马人，就带兵丁下去救他出来。

zhTraditional.text: 這人被猶太人拿住，將要殺害，我得知他是羅馬人，就帶兵丁下去救他出來。

en.text: Desiring to know the cause why they accused him, I brought him down to their council.

zhSimplified.text: 因要知道他们告他的缘故，我就带他下到他们的公会去，

zhTraditional.text: 因要知道他們告他的緣故，我就帶他下到他們的公會去，

en.text: I found him to be accused about questions of their law, but not to be charged with anything worthy of death or of imprisonment.

zhSimplified.text: 便查知他被告是因他们律法的辩论，并没有什么该死该绑的罪名。

zhTraditional.text: 便查知他被告是因他們律法的辯論，並沒有甚麼該死該綁的罪名。

en.text: When I was told that the Jews lay in wait for the man, I sent him to you immediately, charging his accusers also to bring their accusations against him before you. Farewell.”

zhSimplified.text: 后来有人把要害他的计谋告诉我，我就立时解他到你那里去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。」

zhTraditional.text: 後來有人把要害他的計謀告訴我，我就立時解他到你那裏去，又吩咐告他的人在你面前告他。」

en.text: So the soldiers, carrying out their orders, took Paul and brought him by night to Antipatris.

zhSimplified.text: 于是，兵丁照所吩咐他们的，将保罗夜里带到安提帕底。

zhTraditional.text: 於是，兵丁照所吩咐他們的，將保羅夜裏帶到安提帕底。

en.text: But on the next day they left the horsemen to go with him, and returned to the barracks.

zhSimplified.text: 第二天，让马兵护送，他们就回营楼去。

zhTraditional.text: 第二天，讓馬兵護送，他們就回營樓去。

en.text: When they came to Caesarea and delivered the letter to the governor, they also presented Paul to him.

zhSimplified.text: 马兵来到凯撒利亚，把文书呈给巡抚，便叫保罗站在他面前。

zhTraditional.text: 馬兵來到凱撒利亞，把文書呈給巡撫，便叫保羅站在他面前。

en.text: When the governor had read it, he asked what province he was from. When he understood that he was from Cilicia, he said,

zhSimplified.text: 巡抚看了文书，问保罗是哪省的人，既晓得他是基利家人，

zhTraditional.text: 巡撫看了文書，問保羅是哪省的人，既曉得他是基利家人，

en.text: “I will hear you fully when your accusers also arrive.” He commanded that he be kept in Herod’s palace.

zhSimplified.text: 就说：「等告你的人来到，我要细听你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙门里。

zhTraditional.text: 就說：「等告你的人來到，我要細聽你的事」；便吩咐人把他看守在希律的衙門裏。
